content: boa_engine 0.21.1 (2026-03-29): pure-Rust JS engine, ~95.5% test262 conformance, embeds trivially (no C++ toolchain, plain cargo build). rquickjs 0.12.1 (2026-07-06, MSRV 1.87): safe bindings over C QuickJS - very high spec coverage, small footprint, but pulls in a C dependency (cc build). deno_core/rusty_v8: full real-world coverage since it IS V8, but V8 is 600k+ lines of C++, historically ~30min compile (mitigated by prebuilt static libs); heaviest binary/build cost of the three.
